name: unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const T) -> Self
rule: For Rc::<T>::from_raw(ptr) to be safe, if the U in the originating Rc::<U>::into_raw call is unsized, its data pointer must have the same size and alignment as T.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > alloc::rc::Rc < T > { unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const T) -> Self }
expression: The requirement cannot be expressed in the supplied DSL: it exposes neither the originating U nor whether U is unsized, so its size and alignment cannot be compared with T’s.
